testcase.name: Scenario: Sort recent thumbnail cards by name and reverse the order: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-home-recent-documents-source/features/application/home-recent-documents/home-recent-documents.feature:84:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Sort recent thumbnail cards by name and reverse the order ✔ Given the MCAD Software starts with an isolated Recent profile prepared from a disposable copy of `fixtures/cad/home-recent-native` ✔ And the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And recent documents with different names are shown in Grid View ✔ And Sort by is set to Last Opened in descending order ✔ When the user opens the Sort by menu ✔ Then it offers Name, Location, Date Modified, Last Opened, Size and Area ✔ When the user chooses Name ✔ Then the sort field shows Name ✔ And the visible cards are ordered by name in descending order ✔ When the user activates the sort direction control ✔ Then the visible cards are ordered by name in ascending order
